name: Kessler-Syndrome-Factorio-Mod
title: Kessler Syndrome: Scrapsteroids Above Fulgora
author: JKNaughton
description: Fulgora's orbit is choked with centuries of accumulated industrial debris. Scrapsteroids litter the transit lanes and pack the orbital belt in overwhelming numbers. Mine them for scrap — or use advanced Geiger processing to extract depleted uranium fuel cells and nuclear fuel from the radioactive wreckage.
